hero.title: One thought, endless images
hero.text: Describe it in a sentence and let AI create a one-of-a-kind visual.

features.title: Everything you need to create
features.text: From a single prompt to a set of usable images — ideas, styles, references and results all in one place.

conversation.title: Conversational creation
conversation.text: Describe the scene like a chat. Refine characters, settings, lighting and style one sentence at a time.

styles.title: Many styles
styles.text: Photorealistic, anime, watercolor, oil painting, minimalist posters, product shots — find the right look for every use.

batch.title: Batch exploration
batch.text: Generate several variations at once to explore directions, compare compositions and spread out ideas quickly.

reference.title: Reference remix
reference.text: Upload a reference image to keep the subject, swap the background or restyle it — give old assets new life.

hd.title: HD output
hd.text: Ready for avatars, covers, posters, product images and social posts — use your work right away.

credits.title: Flexible credits
credits.text: Buy credits as you need them and pay only for what you generate — great for trying out or creating every day.

steps.title: From idea to image in four steps
steps.text: No design experience or prompt tricks needed — start creating in minutes.

register.title: Create an account
register.text: Sign up for free in seconds, no credit card required. Get credits right after signing up.

describe.title: Describe your idea
describe.text: Start a conversation and describe the image you want. Keep iterating until it clicks.

generate.title: AI generates it
generate.text: AI interprets your prompt and delivers high-quality images in seconds. Generate variations to explore.

share.title: Download & share
share.text: Download in HD or share directly. Every image stays in your history to revisit anytime.

advantages.title: Get from idea to image faster
advantages.text: Works for product showcases, social media visuals, avatars and characters, posters, covers and illustration sketches.

items.noDrawing: No drawing skills needed to put the picture in your head into words.
items.explore: Quickly explore directions for avatars, product images, posters and covers.
items.history: Every generation is saved, and the ones you like can be edited further.
items.credits: Pay-as-you-go credits suit occasional creators and heavy users alike.
